blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Samahan ng Progresibong Kabataan (SPARK) staged a rally outside the Philippine National Police (PNP) headquarters on Wednesday, Nov. 18, calling for the release of more than 200 individuals arrested during recent protests and the dismissal of charges against them. Members of the group gathered in front of Gate 1 at Camp Crame at 10:35 a.m. The protest came after clashes between demonstrators and police during rallies in Muntinlupa on Monday, Nov. 16, and at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila on Sunday, Nov. 15, led to the arrest of more than 200 individuals.
